zh.summary: 恢复 Windows 原生右键菜单，取消第三方插件默认安装，并接入官方 rc.5 内核。
highlights: Windows：恢复输入框和选中文字的原生右键菜单，提供剪切、复制、粘贴和全选；沿用现有下载与保存处理。
内核：新包默认采用官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5；内核资格不再由可选插件的版本名单决定。
插件：新包不再默认安装 Image Viewer 和 Chat Manager；保留已有安装、版本和启用选择，常规管理使用官方页面，新配置首次启动即可进入。
插件入口：移除现代界面的重复高级管理；「更多」仅兼容恢复旧版插件 JSON 配置，日常备份恢复统一使用设置中的「桌面与数据」。
配置恢复：部分依赖失败时保持有效 bundle 顺序，完全失败时还原原配置并准确提示；收紧 profile 和恢复目标的路径与链接检查。
缓存整理：识别官方空插件安装状态，避免误报引用缺失；空配置不执行依赖清理，保留已有恢复材料。
upgradeNotes: 正常退出后更新；已有会话、设置、凭据、插件和工作区保留。
新包内置 rc.5；升级若选择保留当前内核，运行版本仍以保留结果为准，可在内核更新中另行选择。
旧内核更新包若提示尚未适配，请重新下载对应版本的适配包，避免旧应用层覆盖本版修复。
acknowledgements: 感谢 [@ASg-art-max](https://github.com/ASg-art-max) 在 [#236](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/236) 报告 Windows 右键菜单问题。

en.summary: Restores Windows native context menus, makes community plugins optional, and adopts official core rc.5.
highlights: Windows: restores native editing menus for the composer and selected text, with Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all, while retaining the existing download/save handling.
Core: new packages bundle official DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5. Optional plugin version lists no longer govern core qualification.

Plugins: new packages no longer install Image Viewer or Chat Manager by default. Existing installations, versions and enabled choices are preserved; official management is available on the first launch of a fresh profile.
Plugin entry points: removes duplicate modern management. More only imports legacy plugin JSON configurations; routine backup and recovery use Desktop & data in Settings.
Recovery: preserves selected bundle order during partial fallback, restores the previous configuration on complete failure, and validates profile paths and filesystem links.
Cache maintenance: recognizes official empty plugin installations without a false missing-reference error. Empty graphs skip dependency pruning and preserve existing recovery material.
upgradeNotes: Exit normally before updating. Existing sessions, settings, credentials, plugins and workspaces are preserved.
The package bundles rc.5. If an upgrade preserves the current core, the running version follows that result; choose another core separately in core updates.
If an older core update file is reported as unqualified, download its refreshed package to preserve this release’s Portable fixes.
acknowledgements: Thanks to [@ASg-art-max](https://github.com/ASg-art-max) for reporting the Windows context-menu issue in [#236](https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/issues/236).
